summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting an amendment to a senior secured revolving credit facility. The borrower, a wholly-owned subsidiary of PennantPark Private Income Fund, increased borrowing capacity from $120M to $200M; no other terms changed. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation event. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer/filer. No deal terms are applicable.
